title: Paul Mellon's family and support for fascism

tellings.quote: And he said, "Yeah, I mean, he was a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism. So was Henry Ford. So was Watson of IBM.

plain: In the 1930s and early 1940s, a wealthy American named Paul Mellon, or his family, is said to have been a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism, along with the carmaker Henry Ford and Watson, the head of the computer company IBM. Steven Greer, a guest who argues that UFO secrets are held by a global ruling circle, repeats this from a man named John Warner IV, who he says told him directly. If it were true, some of the great American fortunes of that era would have backed fascism, which feeds Greer's picture of who holds the secrets.
